i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0;                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                   \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// 3D index calculation\n__host__ __device__ inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n__global__ void initializeGridKernel(Real* __restrict__ grid, const size_t gridSize) {\n    const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx < gridSize) {\n        grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil computation (one kernel launch per iteration).\n// Interior cells are averaged; boundary cells are copied from the input.\n__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,\n                              const int nx, const int ny, const int nz) {\n    __shared__ Real tile[TZ + 2][TY + 2][TX + 2];\n\n    // Global coordinates of the tile's halo origin (one cell before the block's first cell)\n    const int x0 = blockIdx.x * TX - 1;\n    const int y0 = blockIdx.y * TY - 1;\n    const int z0 = blockIdx.z * TZ - 1;\n\n    // Cooperative load of the tile, including halo, using a flat thread index.\n    // Halo cells outside the grid are never read: only interior cells use the halo,\n    // and those always have all their neighbours inside the grid.\n    constexpr int tileElems = (TX + 2) * (TY + 2) * (TZ + 2);\n    const int nThreads = blockDim.x * blockDim.y * blockDim.z;\n    const int tid = (threadIdx.z * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    for (int t = tid; t < tileElems; t += nThreads) {\n        const int lx = t % (TX + 2);\n        const int ly = (t / (TX + 2)) % (TY + 2);\n        const int lz = t / ((TX + 2) * (TY + 2));\n        const int gx = x0 + lx;\n        const int gy = y0 + ly;\n        const int gz = z0 + lz;\n        if (gx >= 0 && gx < nx && gy >= 0 && gy < ny && gz >= 0 && gz < nz) {\n            tile[lz][ly][lx] = input[idx3(gx, gy, gz, nx, ny)];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int x = blockIdx.x * TX + threadIdx.x;\n    const int y = blockIdx.y * TY + threadIdx.y;\n    const int z = blockIdx.z * TZ + threadIdx.z;\n    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n    const bool interior = x > 0 && x < nx - 1 && y > 0 && y < ny - 1 && z > 0 && z < nz - 1;\n    if (!interior) {\n        output[idx] = input[idx];\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Local tile coordinates of this cell (offset by the halo)\n    const int lx = threadIdx.x + 1;\n    const int ly = threadIdx.y + 1;\n    const int lz = threadIdx.z + 1;\n\n    // Simple averaging stencil (same summation order as the reference implementation)\n    const Real center = tile[lz][ly][lx];\n    const Real left = tile[lz][ly][lx - 1];\n    const Real right = tile[lz][ly][lx + 1];\n    const Real front = tile[lz][ly - 1][lx];\n    const Real back = tile[lz][ly + 1][lx];\n    const Real bottom = tile[lz - 1][ly][lx];\n    const Real top = tile[lz + 1][ly][lx];\n\n    output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n\n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Number of blocks needed to cover n cells with blocks of size b (at least one, so empty grids launch cleanly)\ninline unsigned int blocksFor(const size_t n, const int b) {\n    return static_cast<unsigned int>(std::max<size_t>(1, (n + b - 1) / b));\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n\n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n\n    // Allocate grids on the device (double buffering)\n    Real* d_grid1 = nullptr;\n    Real* d_grid2 = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid1, gridSize * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid2, gridSize * sizeof(Real)));\n\n    const dim3 block(TX, TY, TZ);\n    const dim3 gridDim(blocksFor(nx, TX), blocksFor(ny, TY), blocksFor(nz, TZ));\n    const int inx = static_cast<int>(nx);\n    const int iny = static_cast<int>(ny);\n    const int inz = static_cast<int>(nz);\n\n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGridKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(std::max<size_t>(1, (gridSize + 255) / 256)), 256>>>(d_grid1, gridSize);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    // Finish initialization (and CUDA module loading) before starting the timer\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            stencilKernel<<<gridDim, block>>>(d_grid1, d_grid2, inx, iny, inz);\n        } else {\n            stencilKernel<<<gridDim, block>>>(d_grid2, d_grid1, inx, iny, inz);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n\n    // Copy the final grid back to the host for output and validation\n    const Real* d_finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? d_grid1 : d_grid2;\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<Real> (printResults) {\n            print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid t < tileElems; t += nThreads) {\n        const int lx = t % (TX + 2);\n        const int ly = (t / (TX + 2)) % (TY + 2);\n        const int lz = t / ((TX + 2) * (TY + 2));\n        const int gx = x0 + lx;\n        const int gy = y0 + ly;\n        const int gz = z0 + lz;\n        if (gx >= 0 && gx < nx && gy >= 0 && gy < ny && gz >= 0 && gz < nz) {\n            tile[lz][ly][lx] = input[idx3(gx, gy, gz, nx, ny)];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int x = blockIdx.x * TX + threadIdx.x;\n    const int y = blockIdx.y * TY + threadIdx.y;\n    const int z = blockIdx.z * TZ + threadIdx.z;\n    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n    const bool interior = x > 0 && x < nx - 1 && y > 0 && y < ny - 1 && z > 0 && z < nz - 1;\n    if (!interior) {\n        output[idx] = input[idx];\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Local tile coordinates of this cell (offset by the halo)\n    const int lx = threadIdx.x + 1;\n    const int ly = threadIdx.y + 1;\n    const int lz = threadIdx.z + 1;\n\n    // Simple averaging stencil (same summation order as the reference implementation)\n    const Real center = tile[lz][ly][lx];\n    const Real left = tile[lz][ly][lx - 1];\n    const Real right = tile[lz][ly][lx + 1];\n    const Real front = tile[lz][ly - 1][lx];\n    const Real back = tile[lz][ly + 1][lx];\n    const Real bottom = tile[lz - 1][ly][lx];\n    const Real top = tile[lz + 1][ly][lx];\n\n    output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n\n    // 1. <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\nvoid initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil computation\nvoid stencilIteration(const std::vector<Real>& input, \n                      std::vector<Real>& output,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    // Process interior points (not on boundaries)\n    for (size_t z = 1; z < nz - 1; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 1; y < ny - 1; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                \n                const Real center = input[idx];\n                const Real left = input[idx3(x-1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real right = input[idx3(x+1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real front = input[idx3(x, y-1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real back = input[idx3(x, y+1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real bottom = input[idx3(x, y, z-1, nx, ny)];\n                const Real top = input[idx3(x, y, z+1, nx, ny)];\n                \n                // Simple averaging stencil\n                output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Copy boundary values\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {\n                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                    output[idx] = input[idx];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            stencilIteration(grid1, grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        } else {\n            stencilIteration(grid2, grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    const std::vector<Real>& finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? grid1 : grid2;\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_014NFdk9ghHB6hPGAiVZW1qr","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1aVPjhX1wg5F6yPK1ZU","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The stencil benchmark now runs on the GPU. It is still `stencil3d`, built from the same `stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp`, and its output matches the original CPU program exactly. At 512³ it runs at about 17,500 MCellUpdates/s versus about 350 for the CPU original, roughly 40× faster on the RTX 3090 (sm_86).\n\n**What changed (only two files edited, no new files):**\n\n- **`stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp`**\n  - The init and stencil loops are now CUDA kernels. The stencil kernel stages each 32×4×4 tile plus a one-cell halo in shared memory, so neighbour reads come from shared memory. Each iteration is one kernel launch, with double buffering as before.\n  - Boundary cells are copied in the same kernel, and the arithmetic keeps the original summation order, so results are bit-identical.\n  - Data stays on the device for the whole run. It is copied back only when `-r` or `-v` needs it, after the timer stops.\n  - The timer still covers only the iteration loop. Initialization and CUDA module loading happen before it starts, and a device sync closes the timed region.\n  - CLI options, output format, validation logic, and exit codes are unchanged.\n- **`stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt`**\n  - Enables the CUDA language and compiles the existing `.cpp` as CUDA. `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` defaults to `native`.\n  - Host flags (`-march=native -Wall -Wextra`) go through `-Xcompiler`.\n  - Minimum CMake version is now 3.24, which `native` requires.\n\n**Verification:**\n\n- Hashes, sums, and samples match the original CPU build for 128³ (hash `ebb48bc9f8de2959`), non-cubic and non-tile-multiple sizes (256×200×96, 37×19×23, 130×65×70), odd and even iteration counts, zero iterations, and tiny grids of size 1, 2, and 3.\n- The clean rebuild has no warnings.\n\n**Choices I made:**\n\n- The tile shape is 32×4×4. I swept six shapes and they all land within a few percent of each other, so I kept the first one.\n- I left the 128³ default in place, where the GPU is mostly idle (about 2 ms). Larger grids show the throughput.\n- Timing is still millisecond-resolution `chrono`, as in the original. Small runs are coarse.\n\nI built in `/tmp` to keep the repo clean. The project isn't a git repo, so I did not commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":678,"cache_read_input_tokens":46301,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":678},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1581dbe2-9f29-4111-93b0-12f247351425","uuid":"62d015d4-45ea-4673-8400-a64b09d65a57","timestamp":"2026-10-14T05:29:08.864Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1aVPRrJ1vK3QvSduE2Y"}
